x: Pope led the way for the first few miles but later Presland and Hyde fought the race out in very determined fashion.

A turn-up was seen in Herne Hill Harriers 10 mile walking championship, the winner being D. H Sayer, who by beating Reddish and Presland, reversed the result of their 7 miles, in which he finished third.
…this season would, no doubt, have welcomed a training spin as a respite from the keen struggle which always ensues when Presland, Sayer, Reddish and Co. are met in open competition.…

From the pistol Cooper led and completed the course in the fast time of 6min. 46sec. The youthful Hancock was second in 6min. 57sec., and was followed by Presland (H.H.H.) a former Junior Champion, and our Walking Hon.
Surrey A.C. through a great run by Presland had come through from 15th to 3rd and Portsmouth 'B' team turning the tables on their 'A' team runner Frank Salvat were up to 6th with their 'A' team 9th.
Charlie kept his nose in front, but only just and Gerry North set off with a slender 2 second lead which Presland of the home club soon closed.

Halton, Geoff finished second to Briault in the Sefton Brancker Trophy match between the Civil Service, Middlesex and the R.A.F In leading the Civil Service team to victory Geoff easily beat Price, Pugh, Presland, Barratt, Cooper, Ellis, Entwistle, Mellor, Lindsell and Holts.
Laurie soon worked his way up to third and entered into a lengthy battle with Presland of Surrey AC. Gilson faded a little and soon had Major and Reilly closing on him.

Left on his own for some time he probably felt in the latter stages that he would at least salvage second place, but the field had closed up alarmingly behind and in the last mile or so Barratt, Heaver, Franklin, and Briault all swept past with Badgery, Presland and Graham close behind.
Fastest of Day: Presland (SAC) 15:13, Wands (Hill) 15:24, Francis (Hill) 15:31
Presland took Aldershot into the lead on leg 3 but running even better was Standing (Brighton) who cut through the opposition to gain 2nd, only 8 secs. down, with 24:02.
